summary: Verified all requested features across Dashboard, Planning, Interventions and Equipments. Found and fixed one critical bug (missing useNavigate import in Dashboard.jsx crashing the whole Dashboard). All other flows working end-to-end.

minor.issue: _formation_event_days & dashboard/calendar parse date_debut strictly with strptime('%Y-%m-%d'); silently returns [] if date is stored as ISO datetime (e.g., '2026-07-18T08:00:00'). Frontend currently sends YYYY-MM-DD via <input type="date"> so no user impact, but robustness against ISO input is missing (curl tests using ISO datetime silently disappear from planning/dashboard).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by test agent: useNavigate was used at line 62 but not imported, causing 'ReferenceError: useNavigate is not defined' and full Dashboard crash. Added useNavigate to the react-router-dom import on line 2.

action_items: Consider hardening backend date parsing in _formation_event_days and dashboard calendar formation branch to also accept ISO datetime strings (fromisoformat fallback) so external API clients don't get silently empty results.
Add an ErrorBoundary around the app so a single component crash (like the Dashboard useNavigate one) doesn't render the red overlay for the whole page.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx grew to 844 lines (formation modal + agenda IIFE inline). Consider extracting FormationModal, WeeklyAgenda and CompressorHours into separate components (>700 line rule).
Interventions.jsx eye buttons on 3008 rows have no data-testid on the row-level detail trigger; adding data-testid={`interv-detail-${item.id}`} on the ghost button would make testing more reliable.
backend/server.py: _formation_event_days uses strict '%Y-%m-%d' — use datetime.fromisoformat / date parsing helper to be format-agnostic.

success_rate.backend: 100% (formations CRUD, planning/events, dashboard/calendar, interventions PUT, PDF upload/delete, technicians endpoint excludes admin)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 temporary formations (TEST_Formation_Auto, TEST_UI_Formation) via API/UI, uploaded and deleted a test PDF on the first intervention, temporarily edited intervention observations. All cleaned up: formations deleted (list empty of TEST_*), PDF deleted, observations reverted to original text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (a) Dashboard weekly-agenda renders 81+ items grouped by week, agenda-item-* clicks navigate to /ordres-travail and open the WO detail modal via WorkOrders openId state; (b) alert-item-0 click navigates to /controles; upcoming-item-0 opens a work order detail modal; (c) Add Formation modal saves with SearchableSelect allowCustom (must click cmdk '[cmdk-item]' 'Utiliser « ... »' to commit the custom typed name before Save enables), formation appears in Dashboard list, Planning /planning month view as purple entries with GraduationCap icon on each covered day, and in dashboard weekly agenda; (d) Intervention detail modal shows Pièces utilisées, PV / Documents PDF with 'Ajouter un PDF' upload, and Rectifier button for admin; (e) PDF upload + delete via data-testid interv-pdf-input/interv-pdf-item/interv-pdf-delete works; (f) Rectifier saves observations, list row count unchanged (3008), value persists after reopen; (g) Equipments edit -> statut Réformé reveals Date, Motif, and Technicien responsable (data-testid select-technicien-reforme SearchableSelect). Technicians API returns [] (no non-admin techs seeded), and admin is correctly excluded. Frontend uses <input type='date'> for formation dates so backend receives YYYY-MM-DD (matches strict strptime).
rca of the issue: Root cause of Dashboard crash: /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx used `const navigate = useNavigate();` (line 62) inside the goToAlert / goToUpcoming handlers but the import only had `{ Link }` from 'react-router-dom'. Reproduction: login as admin -> Dashboard route -> React error overlay 'ReferenceError: useNavigate is not defined'. Fix applied: replaced `import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';` with `import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';`. Verified fix by re-loading Dashboard: weekly-agenda, alerts, upcoming, add-formation-btn and all click navigations now function.
